notes: Purpose: compact operations sheet for QBR prep and renewal huddle. Use this as the single source for next-step actions prior to the weekly CS renewal review. Rows reflect currently engaged accounts (Voyager cohort). Color-coding (not captured here) in the live sheet: red = high risk, amber = medium, green = low. The owner field is the named CSM responsible for execution.
assumptions: Probability is an internal CSM estimate factoring engagement signals, exec sponsorship, and product-fit. Weighted ARR = ARR * Probability. Expansion Opp is an estimated upside and is not included in weighted ARR. Dates are conservative: Next Step Due reflects target action, not contractual deadline.
next_actions_summary: Top 3 blockers: 1) Harbor Financial legal/data residency (owner: Aaron) — escalate to Legal with precedent bundle; 2) Nimbus Retail price pushback — arrange exec-to-exec value demo (+growth case study); 3) OpenLane Media budget risk — propose short-term usage cap + ROI metrics to avoid churn. Action: owners to log playbook PR in Confluence and attach supporting evals before 2026-10-10.
quick_formulas: Weighted ARR (per row) = ARR (USD) * Renewal Probability. Pipeline coverage = Total weighted ARR / Quarterly renewal target. Suggested adoption: map these formulas into the sheet cells for live tracking (SUM over Weighted ARR column).
